extensions.name: SaaS Landing Page

extensions.name: E-Commerce Store
extensions.author: Nuvra Team
extensions.description: A full e-commerce store template with product listings, cart, checkout, and order management. Includes Products and Orders data collections.
extensions.longDescription: A complete e-commerce solution with product catalog, shopping cart, checkout flow, and order management dashboard. Includes pre-built data schemas for Products, Orders, and Customers.

extensions.name: Chart & Data Blocks
extensions.author: Nuvra Team
extensions.description: Adds 8 chart and data visualisation blocks powered by Chart.js: bar, line, pie, doughnut, area, scatter, stat card, and data table.
extensions.longDescription: A comprehensive set of chart blocks for building dashboards and data-rich applications. All charts are responsive and mobile-friendly. Uses Chart.js loaded from CDN.

extensions.name: Stripe Payments
extensions.author: Nuvra Team
extensions.description: Accept payments in your Nuvra apps with Stripe. Adds payment form blocks, checkout flow, and a Stripe webhook data schema.
extensions.longDescription: Integrate Stripe payments into any Nuvra project. Includes a payment form block, Stripe.js injection, a payments data collection for tracking transactions, and a webhook schema for order fulfilment.

extensions.name: Firebase Integration
extensions.author: Nuvra Team
extensions.description: Connect your Nuvra apps to Firebase Firestore for real-time data, Firebase Auth for user management, and Firebase Storage for file uploads.
extensions.longDescription: A full Firebase integration for Nuvra. Provides real-time data binding blocks, Firebase Auth sign-in blocks, and file upload components. Requires a Firebase project.

extensions.name: SaaS AI Pack
extensions.author: Nuvra Team
extensions.description: Extends Nuvra AI with deep SaaS domain knowledge. Generates subscription flows, pricing pages, onboarding sequences, and admin dashboards with expert-level accuracy.
extensions.longDescription: The SaaS AI Pack teaches Nuvra's AI engine to understand SaaS-specific patterns: MRR/ARR dashboards, subscription tiers, trial flows, churn analysis, and B2B onboarding. When installed, AI generation automatically uses SaaS best practices without any extra prompting.

extensions.name: E-Commerce AI Pack
extensions.author: Nuvra Team
extensions.description: Extends Nuvra AI with e-commerce expertise. Generates product catalogs, shopping carts, checkout flows, inventory management, and order tracking with conversion-optimised patterns.
extensions.longDescription: The E-Commerce AI Pack gives Nuvra's AI deep knowledge of online retail patterns: product listings, cart management, checkout optimisation, inventory tracking, and customer management. Generates conversion-optimised layouts based on e-commerce best practices.

extensions.name: Internal Tools AI Pack
extensions.author: Nuvra Team
extensions.description: Extends Nuvra AI with internal tooling expertise. Generates CRUD admin panels, data tables, approval workflows, and reporting dashboards optimised for internal business use.
extensions.longDescription: The Internal Tools AI Pack specialises in generating business-internal applications: admin panels, data management tools, approval workflows, reporting dashboards, and employee portals. Optimised for productivity over aesthetics.
